errors.startFailed: We couldn't reach the Business Platform. Try again in a moment.
errors.notConfigured: Sign-in with the Business Platform isn't available here.

redirect.title: Taking you to the Business Platform
redirect.body: Sign in there, and you'll come straight back.

callback.deniedBody: You didn't allow VirtualBiz to sign you in with the Business Platform. Nothing was changed.
callback.loginTitle: Sign in to the Business Platform first
callback.loginBody: You're not signed in to the Business Platform, or haven't allowed VirtualBiz yet. Start again to sign in there.
callback.expiredBody: Sign-in links work once, for a few minutes, in the browser that started them. Start again.
callback.suspendedBody: Contact VirtualBiz through the Help page.
callback.unavailableBody: It isn't set up on this server. Sign in another way.
callback.missingBody: This page finishes a sign-in with the Business Platform. Start one from the sign-in page.

link.title: You already have a VirtualBiz account
link.lead: An account with {email} already exists. To use the Business Platform with it, sign in to it once the usual way and confirm.
link.why: We never join accounts on email alone, so nobody else can take over yours.
link.confirmLead: From now on, “Continue with Business Platform” signs you in to {account}.
link.wrongAccount: You're signed in to a different account. Sign in to the account with the platform's email.
link.conflict: This Business Platform account, or this VirtualBiz account, is already linked to another one.
link.failed: We couldn't link the accounts. Try again.

open.missingBody: This link doesn't name a shop. Open it again from the Business Platform.
open.noAccessTitle: You don't have access to this shop
open.noAccessBody: Ask the shop's owner, or an admin of its organisation on the Business Platform, to add you.

connect.title: Connect a shop to the Business Platform
connect.lead: Choose one of your shops and the organisation to link it to. The organisation's members get access to the shop: owners and admins as managers, members as staff.
connect.noShopsTitle: You don't own a shop yet
connect.noShopsBody: Only a shop's owner can connect it. Create your shop first.
connect.noOrgsBody: You need to be an owner or admin of an organisation on the Business Platform.
connect.doneBody: {shop} is now linked to {org}. Its members can open the shop from the Business Platform.
connect.expiredBody: Connecting a shop needs a fresh Business Platform sign-in. Start again.
connect.forbidden: You can't connect this shop to that organisation.
connect.failed: We couldn't connect the shop. Try again.

panel.title: Business Platform
panel.sub: Link this shop to an organisation on the Business Platform. Its members then reach the shop from there, with access that follows their role.
panel.confirm: Disconnect from {org}? People who got access through the organisation lose it now.
panel.ownerOnly: Only the shop's owner can connect or disconnect it.
